item.title: Meet Nkechi Okenwa, the Engineer Helping More Nigerian Women Break Into Renewable Energy
item.description: In Nigeria, where renewable energy is increasingly becoming a necessity rather than an alternative, women like Nkechi Okenwa are working to bridge both gaps at once, bringing clean energy solutions to underserved communities while creating pathways for more women to enter the sector. The post Meet Nkechi Okenwa, the Engineer Helping More Nigerian Women Break Into Renewable Energy appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world. Read today! .
